caption: The drawing depicts a single hammer with a wooden handle and a metallic head positioned horizontally across the center of the plain, beige background. The handle is brown with visible wood grain texture and has a string or cord looped through a hole at its end, drooping downward and somewhat looped. The head of the hammer is dark-colored, appearing metallic, and has two distinct sections: a flat striking surface and a rounded peen with a spiral-shaped detail. The area where the handle meets the head is wrapped with a dark material, possibly leather or fabric. The overall composition centers the hammer, and to the lower right of the image, there is a small inscription that reads “FRANK VOLEM 1 3 39.”
title: Log Marker
